title: AI demand sidelines auto memory contracts, raising supply alarms
snippet: Surging demand for high-bandwidth, high-capacity memory for AI is pushing global memory giants to concentrate production and R&D resources on higher-margin products, squeezing long-term contracts for automotive memory. As memory suppliers grow reluctant to navigate automakers' lengthy contracting procedures, Taiwanese memory companies are benefiting, although mainstream automakers' requirements are unlikely to change amid the production reallocation.

title: Dell's AI infrastructure surge reshapes its earnings mix
snippet: Dell Technologies' fiscal third-quarter results show its growth engine shifting decisively toward infrastructure. AI-optimized servers and related data center products drove most of the expansion, and operating profit rose faster than revenue. The scale of the increase, along with the company's larger full-year forecast, suggests enterprise demand for AI systems is translating into shipments. It also leaves results increasingly exposed to the pace and economics of server deployments.

title: Symtek sees 1H27 demand holding firm on overseas orders

title: Intel 18A yield hits 70%, targets AMD with 14A process

Intel has provided customers with the process design kit (PDK) 0.9 and targets the release of PDK 1.0 in the first quarter of 2027, with 14A risk production expected in the second half of 2027 and mass production beginning in 2028.

title: Global smartphone shipments forecast to fall nearly 25% YoY in 4Q26 amid prolonged slump
snippet: The global smartphone market is set for a muted peak season in the fourth quarter of 2026, with shipments projected to decline nearly 25% year-over-year. The prolonged market downturn is driven by lengthening replacement cycles, rising costs for memory and other upstream components, and a strategic pullback by brands from mid- to low-end models.

title: AI and cloud demand drive Taiwan manufacturing output higher

title: ObjectOutputStream без reset(): как сериализация тихо съедает хип
